text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan) (Objek Bersejarah) 2011.

Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Objek bersejarah yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang telah diisytiharkan sebagai

objek warisan dalam Perisytiharan Objek Warisan (Objek Bersejarah) (No. 3) 2010

[P.U. (B) 374/2010] yang disiarkan dalam Warta pada 19 Ogos 2010 dan disenaraikan

dalam Daftar diisytiharkan sebagai suatu Warisan Kebangsaan.

JADUAL

Cokmar Dewan Rakyat

Cokmar Dewan Negara

Dibuat 1 Ogos 2011

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/2; PN(PU2)652/VIII]

DATO' SERI UTAMA DR. RAIS YATIM

 Menteri Penerangan, Komunikasi dan Kebudayaan

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HISTORICAL OBJECT) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the National Heritage

Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of National

Heritage) (Historical Object) Order 2011.

National Heritage

2. The historical objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as

heritage objects in the Declaration of Heritage Object (Historical Object) (No. 3) 2010

[P.U. (B) 374/2010] as published in the Gazette on 19 August 2010 and listed in the

Register are declared to be National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

The Mace of the House Representatives

The Mace of the Senate

Made 1 August 2011

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/2; PN(PU2)652/VIII]

DATO' SERI UTAMA DR. RAIS YATIM

Minister of Information, Communications and Culture
